creationWorkflow.step1: Create Shader Graph in Unity: Assets → Create → Shader Graph → URP → Lit Shader Graph
creationWorkflow.step2: Name according to master material (Stone_Tartarian.shadergraph, etc.)
creationWorkflow.step3: Add properties as Blackboard variables (right panel)
creationWorkflow.step4: Build node network following shaderGraphNodes array above
creationWorkflow.step5: Connect to Lit Master Node (Fragment shader)
creationWorkflow.step7: Create Material instance: Assets → Create → Material
creationWorkflow.step8: Assign Shader Graph to material (Shader dropdown)
creationWorkflow.step10: Save material with Moon1 suffix naming

commonNodes.textureMapping: UV → Tiling and Offset → Texture Sample
commonNodes.emission: HDR Color Property → Multiply (Intensity) → Multiply (Mask) → Emission
commonNodes.normalMap: Texture Sample (Normal) → Normal Strength → Normal Unpack

performanceNotes: Emission adds minimal cost (just pixel shader math)
Fresnel rim lights are cheap (view-dependent calculation)
Texture samples are moderate cost (4 textures = good balance)
Refraction is VERY expensive - disable for Phase 1, add in Phase 4 polish
